title: 10 创收与尝试11 义字当头
content_zh:
……
“城里管这么很严，禁止打架斗殴，他们两兄弟这么做官府不管？”林哲羽问道。
“只要不明面上动手，下手时不闹出人命，对方宗亲友人不到官府中闹事，官府就不会管。”
吴管事苦笑道，这个世道就是这么残酷。
“那上一任管事的宗亲们不去闹事？”林哲羽好奇道。
这个世界里，宗亲氏族间都是互相帮扶，只要有人出事，就会一起帮忙出头的。
“摆平了。”
“贾彦明出面补偿了些许银两，加上贾彦勇的武力威慑，还有飞虹帮的人出面，将闹事的宗亲都摆平了。”
吴管事说道。
这个世界很残酷，隐藏在和平的面纱下，是残酷的丛林法则。
“这样啊……”
林哲羽心中升起警惕，继续问道：“贾彦勇什么实力你清楚么？”
他才开始正是练武，之前都是站的桩功，实力不是很强，担心打不过。
“这就不清楚了。”
“那人我见过，块头很大，身高足有一米九，比我还壮硕。他长相极其凶狠，身上伤疤众多，估计杀过人。”
吴管事凝重道。
林哲羽眉头微皱。
生活在这种落后的社会文明就是麻烦，社会制度的不完善，对他们这种孤身在外闯荡的人太不友好了。
“要不你去我那儿住吧！”
“我们吴家壮丁众多，吴家村极为团结，他们不敢在吴家村动手的。”

“你孤身一人在松宜城，没有亲族作为后盾，他们动起手来就更肆无忌惮了。”吴管事建议道。
“不用。”
“实在没办法的话，我再去你家借住吧。”
林哲羽摇头，他不习惯住别人家。
实在不行的话，就加入溢香茶楼得了，这不就是贾彦明的目的么？
到那时自己再写几個好故事，让吴管事雇人说书，自己收取版权费用，还能够创收。
‘咦，这主意可行！’
林哲羽越琢磨越觉得这主意不错。
……
两个小时的说书结束，林哲羽毫无例外引来满堂喝彩。
今天来了不少公子哥，这些公子哥打赏起来极为豪横，看得林哲羽身心舒畅。
“这故事的主角怎么还是书生，听着真腻歪。”梁松剥了颗花生扔进嘴里吐槽道。
林哲羽从来到碧丹茶楼说书开始，说的便都是聊斋系列故事。
故事几乎都是花妖狐媚与书生的不可说·伦之恋，虽然都很精彩。
content_en:
…
"The city is so strict that fighting is prohibited, but the government doesn't care what these two brothers did?" Lin Zheyu asked.
"As long as you don't do it openly, don't kill people when you do it, and the other party's relatives and friends don't make trouble in the government, the government will not care about it."
Manager Wu smiled bitterly and said, this world is so cruel.
"Then the clan members who were in charge of the previous affairs didn't make trouble?" Lin Zheyu asked curiously.
In this world, clans and clans all help each other. As long as someone is in trouble, they will work together to help.
"Settled."
"Jia Yanming came forward to compensate for some silver. Coupled with Jia Yanyong's force deterrence, and people from the Feihong Gang came forward to settle the troubled clan members."
Manager Wu said.
This world is cruel. Hidden under the veil of peace is the cruel law of the jungle.
"That's it..."
Lin Zheyu felt wary and continued to ask, "Do you know what Jia Yanyong's strength is?"
He had just started practicing martial arts. Before, he had only done standing exercises. His strength was not very strong and he was worried that he would not be able to defeat him.
"That's not clear."
"I've seen that man before. He's very big. He's 1.9 meters tall. He's stronger than me. He looks extremely fierce and has many scars on his body. He must have killed people."
Manager Wu said solemnly.
Lin Zheyu frowned slightly.
Living in such a backward social civilization is troublesome. The imperfect social system is too unfriendly to people like them who are wandering alone.
"Why don't you come and live at my place!"
"We have many strong men in the Wu family, and the Wu family village is extremely united. They dare not take action in the Wu family village."
"You are alone in Songyicheng, without any relatives to back you up, so they will be even more unscrupulous when they take action." Manager Wu suggested.
"No need."
"If there's nothing I can do, I'll stay at your house again."
Lin Zheyu shook his head. He was not used to living in other people's homes.
If that doesn't work, just join Yixiang Teahouse. Isn't this Jia Yanming's purpose?
At that time, I will write a few good stories, let Manager Wu hire storytellers, collect copyright fees myself, and still generate income.
‘Hey, this idea works! ’
The more Lin Zheyu thought about it, the more he thought it was a good idea.
…
At the end of the two-hour storytelling, Lin Zheyu drew applause from the audience without exception.
Many young masters came today, and these young masters were extremely arrogant in their rewards, which made Lin Zheyu feel comfortable both physically and mentally.
"Why is the protagonist of this story still a scholar? It sounds so boring." Liang Song peeled off a peanut and threw it into his mouth and complained.
From the time Lin Zheyu came to Bidan Tea House to tell stories, he always told stories from the Liao Zhai series.
The stories are almost all about the unspeakable love between the flower demon Hu Mei and the scholar, although they are all wonderful.
